target.lesson_title: Chapter 5: Mechanical Fasteners — Chi tiết kẹp chặt (chốt nối cơ khí)

exam.title: Kiểm tra 30 phút Chapter 5: Mechanical Fasteners

questions.question: A device used to hold two or more things together.
questions.explanation: hold … together (giữ … lại với nhau) → fastener, chốt nối.

questions.question: A fastener with a thread that is turned into a surface.
questions.explanation: a thread that is turned (có ren, được vặn vào) → screw. Đinh (nail) thân trơn, không có ren.

questions.question: A threaded fastener used with a nut to press pieces together.
questions.explanation: with a nut (đi với đai ốc) → bolt.

questions.question: The helical grooves on the outside of a bolt or screw.
questions.explanation: grooves (rãnh) quanh thân → thread, ren.

questions.question: A bolt head with six sides, turned by a spanner.
questions.explanation: six sides (sáu cạnh) + spanner → hex head, đầu lục giác.

questions.question: A bolt head with a hexagonal hole in its top.
questions.explanation: hole in its top (lỗ ở đỉnh) → socket head, vặn bằng chìa lục giác.

questions.question: In the direction of clock hands; a nut is screwed on this way.
questions.explanation: clock hands (kim đồng hồ) → clockwise.

questions.question: A hollow rivet fitted with a rivet gun.
questions.explanation: hollow (rỗng) + rivet gun → blind rivet.

questions.question: Which word means "vòng đệm, long đền"?
questions.explanation: Vòng đệm đặt giữa đai ốc và bề mặt → washer.

questions.question: Which word means "đinh tán"?
questions.explanation: Đinh tán là chốt nối vĩnh viễn → rivet. Nail là đinh đóng, bolt là bu lông.

questions.question:
Article 2
A bolt with a nut is a very common fastener (or fixing). Bolts have threads – grooves on the outside of the bolt's shaft (or shank), which run around the shaft in a helical pattern. The threaded shaft allows a nut, which has a thread inside it, to be screwed onto the bolt (by a turning motion). Nuts usually have a right-hand thread – they are screwed on by turning them clockwise (in the direction of clock hands) and unscrewed by turning them anticlockwise. However, in some situations, left-hand threads are used. Most bolts have heads with hexagonal perimeters (hexagonal heads or hex heads). These allow a spanner to turn them. Heads can also have a hexagonal hole in their top, called a socket head. This allows a hex key (or Allen key) to fit into them.

The threaded shaft allows a nut to be ______ onto the bolt.
questions.explanation: Article 2: to be screwed onto the bolt.

questions.question:
Article 3
Rivets are permanent fasteners – they cannot be unscrewed. A solid rivet consists of a short, solid shaft of metal with a head at one end, called the factory head. The rivet is inserted through a pre-drilled hole, then a special tool is used to deform (change the shape of) the other end of the rivet, flattening and widening it to form a second head, called the shop head. Solid rivets are widely used in aircraft. Blind rivets (or pop rivets) are made from hollow tubes, and are fitted using a tool called a rivet gun. Blind rivets are not suitable for high-strength joints.

A solid rivet has a head at one end, called the ______ head.
questions.explanation: Article 3: called the factory head. Shop head là đầu thứ hai, tạo ra sau khi tán.

questions.explanation: Article 3: made from hollow tubes. Solid rivet mới là loại đặc.

questions.question: Article 1. Use an ______ for situations requiring extra support.
questions.explanation: Article 1: Use an anchor for situations requiring extra support. Trước chỗ trống là an.

questions.question: Nails are ______ for walls and wood surfaces.
questions.explanation: ideal for = rất hợp với. Hollow (rỗng), clockwise (theo chiều kim đồng hồ) không đi với for ở đây.

questions.question: Wood screws are best for ______ wood surfaces.
questions.explanation: solid wood = gỗ đặc.

questions.question: Article 1. Get the right washers and nuts to add strength and prevent damage to ______.
questions.explanation: Article 1: prevent damage to surfaces (tránh làm hỏng bề mặt).

questions.question: This store carries both UTS thread and ______ thread measurements.
questions.explanation: UTS là hệ inch, đi cặp với metric (hệ mét).

questions.question: Use ______ when pressing pieces together from both sides.
questions.explanation: Bolt đi với nut: ép chi tiết lại từ hai phía.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "These allow a spanner to turn them."
options: Cờ lê không thể vặn chúng.
Chúng được làm bằng cờ lê.
Chúng giúp cờ lê vặn được chúng.
Cờ lê giúp chúng không bị gỉ.
questions.explanation: Mẫu X allows Y to V = X giúp / cho phép Y làm V.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "Rivets are permanent fasteners – they cannot be unscrewed."
options: Đinh tán là chốt nối vĩnh viễn, không thể vặn ra được.
Đinh tán là chốt nối tạm thời, vặn ra được.
Đinh tán là chốt nối rỗng, không có ren.
Đinh tán là dụng cụ để vặn đai ốc.
questions.explanation: permanent = vĩnh viễn; cannot be unscrewed = không thể vặn ra.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "Blind rivets are not suitable for high-strength joints."
options: Đinh tán rút không phù hợp cho mối ghép chịu lực cao.
Đinh tán rút rất phù hợp cho mối ghép chịu lực cao.
Đinh tán rút được lắp bằng kìm rút.
Đinh tán rút làm từ thanh đặc.
questions.explanation: not suitable for = không phù hợp với; high-strength joints = mối ghép chịu lực cao.

Mark each statement True or False.

statements.text: Bolts have threads on the outside of the shaft.
Nuts are usually unscrewed by turning them clockwise.
A hex key fits into a socket head.
Hexagonal heads allow a hex key to turn them.

questions.explanation: Hex head dùng cờ lê (spanner); socket head mới dùng hex key. Nuts: vặn vào theo chiều kim đồng hồ, tháo ra ngược chiều.

Blind rivets are fitted using a rivet gun.
